# Getting help

- **How do I…?** — check the [README](https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode#readme) and the [docs](https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode/tree/main/docs) first.
- **Questions and ideas** — ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode/discussions).
- **Bugs** — [open an issue](https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode/issues) with your Pockode version (`pockode -version`) and steps to reproduce.
- **Security problems** — report them privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
